meta.title: 3204 Colony Club Rd Apt 6, Pompano Beach, FL 33062
meta.note: Facts gathered from public listings, city and county documents, and state law summaries on 2026-10-21. Fields marked unknown were not available in public sources and are the first questions to ask.

priceHistory.event: Listed (MLS F10524066, shown as 878 sq ft, 1.5 baths)
Price cut (shown as for sale by owner on Zillow)

listingDiscrepancies: Zillow shows 2 full baths and 900 sq ft; the MLS record (F10524066), Homes.com and Trulia's structured data show 1.5 baths and 878 sq ft.
The 0.82-acre lot is the whole complex parcel, not land that comes with the unit.
property.parking: 1 carport space (per rental listing for Unit 1 in the same building)
property.salesHistoryNote: No recorded prior sale for Apt 6 appeared in public listing sites. Pull the Broward County Property Appraiser record (web.bcpa.net) for deed history and the recorded condo book/page.

building.name: Silver Thatch Apartment Buildings (Colony Club Rd low-rises, 3204 to 3213)
building.habitableStoriesNote: Neighboring 3205 Colony Club Rd is described as a 2-story building with 6 units; 3204 has at least units 1 to 6. Two stories is likely, which would exempt the building from the state milestone inspection and SIRS but not from Broward's 40/50-year recertification.
building.construction: CBS (concrete block) typical for 1963 coastal low-rise; verify
building.recertNote: A 1963 building was due for Broward recertification in 2003, 2013 and 2023; next in 2033.
building.renovatedYear: 1988 shown on a neighboring unit's public record (3212 #6); unknown for this unit

association.name: unknown (city association list shows an association registered at 3204 Colony Club Rd Apt 3)
association.rentalMinDays: unknown (a furnished unit in this building rented on a yearly lease and seasonally with a 45-day minimum)
association.pets: unknown (neighboring 3209 and 3213 Colony Club Rd list no pets)

financing.rateNote: 30-year fixed average 7.32% on 2026-10-16 (Zillow); Freddie Mac weekly 7.28% on 2026-10-01.

location.summary: On the barrier island between the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic, about one block from the sand and roughly 1,500 ft from the Pompano Beach pier and Fishing Village (Beach House, Oceanic, Lucky Fish, the Briny). Hillsboro Inlet, the lighthouse and the charter fleet are about a mile north. Car-dependent for groceries; Publix and Pompano Citi Centre are across the Intracoastal on Federal Highway.
location.floodZoneNote: Not confirmed. New FEMA coastal maps effective 2024-07-31. Nearby 33062 parcels show AE; the A1A ridge has X pockets. Confirm with FEMA MSC and the city Building Division (954-786-4669).
location.walkScoreNote: Walk Score reports 42 to 56 for addresses on Colony Club Rd; the Beach neighborhood averages 43 (car-dependent).

firstStreet.note: First Street scores for the unit were not published; a 33062 comparison parcel (801 S Federal Hwy) shows Flood: Major, Fire: Minimal, Heat: Extreme, Wind: Extreme with a 99% chance of a strong wind event in 30 years. Citywide Pompano Beach: flood moderate, wind extreme, heat extreme.

location.airport: Pompano Beach Airpark about 2.5 miles west; historic helicopter-training noise complaints, mostly over neighborhoods near the field.

schools.note: Broward County Public Schools. Assignment for this address must be confirmed with the district locator; the nearest zoned schools are in the 33060/33064 area across the Intracoastal. Pompano Beach High (600 NE 13th Ave) is an A-rated all-magnet school by application, not by address. Cresthaven Elementary (33064) earned a B in 2024-25 after a run of Cs.

location.transit: No rail on the island. Tri-Rail Pompano Beach station is at NW 8th Ave and 35th St; Brightline's nearest stops are Boca Raton and Fort Lauderdale. Broward County Transit route 11 runs A1A.
location.commute: I-95 via Atlantic Blvd about 12 minutes; Fort Lauderdale downtown about 30 minutes; FLL airport about 35 minutes; Boca Raton about 25 minutes.

demographics.vacantNote: High vacancy is seasonal and second-home stock, not distress.
demographics.source: US Census ACS 2024 5-year estimates via zip-codes.com

crime.note: Citywide figures (2024 FBI data via NeighborhoodScout; violent figure per Proximitii). Sources disagree on whether Pompano's violent rate is above or below national. Incidents concentrate inland and in the northwest; the beach is among the quieter areas, with car break-ins at beach parking the common complaint.

market.medianPricePerSqftNote: Average asking price per sq ft for Pompano Beach condo listings, 2026-05 (skewed up by oceanfront towers). Broward county-wide condo median sold price per sq ft was about $206, down 8% year over year, in the 2026 winter season.
market.note: Pompano Beach Realty monthly report, September 2026: condo median $256,500 (+2.6%), 8.9 months of supply (down from 11.1 a year earlier). Broward condo median $255,000 (-4% YoY) in July 2026.
market.vintageHeadwind: About 85% of South Florida condos listed for sale are 30 or more years old, and the price index for 'vintage' Broward buildings has lagged the market since the 2022 reforms. Buyers are paying a premium for post-2000 buildings with completed inspections and funded reserves.

comps.note: Lions Gate Silver Thatch; closest active comp
Public record: Silver Thatch Apartment Building 4, renovated 1988

development.title: W Pompano hotel-condo tower at 20 N Ocean Dr (ground-breaking expected 2026, opening 2029)
development.why: A 24-story Related Group and Marriott project at the pier end of the beach. Three years of construction traffic and noise within a few blocks, then a higher-end anchor that lifts nearby values.
development.action: Check the construction staging plan and haul route at the city.

development.title: 75-acre downtown redevelopment (Atlantic Blvd and Dixie Hwy, RocaPoint; new city hall starting 2026)
development.why: About 4 million sq ft of mixed use three miles west. Adds restaurants, jobs and traffic on Atlantic Blvd, the island's main link to I-95.

development.title: Oceanfront tower wave: Casamar and Solemar open; Ritz-Carlton Residences (2026) and Waldorf Astoria (2027) finishing to the south; Armani/Casa in review
development.why: Pompano's beach is repricing upward at the top end. That supports land value under older low-rises and raises the odds of a developer offer for a 0.82-acre parcel, but also raises insurance and tax reference points citywide.

development.title: Beach renourishment cycle
development.why: Hurricane Nicole (2022) washed out trucked-in sand from NE 16th St north to Hillsboro Inlet. Broward's shore protection program and the Army Corps re-nourish on a multi-year cycle; the stretch nearest the inlet erodes fastest.

insurance.note: No quotes obtained. Planning range for an older coastal Broward unit: HO-6 $1,500 to $2,800/yr; NFIP contents $450 to $1,500/yr. Citizens rates fell an average 8.7% at spring 2026 renewals.

timeline.event: Building completed; Pompano Beach's barrier island was mostly two-story rental apartments and motels.
Renovation year recorded on a neighboring Silver Thatch unit; probable conversion or refurbishment era for the complex.
Hurricane Wilma: widespread roof damage and a boil-water order in Pompano Beach.
Hurricane Irma: east-coast surge and wind; downed trees across Pompano.
Neighboring 2-bed units sold for $175,000 to $225,000. Surfside collapse (June) triggers Florida's condo safety reforms.
Hurricane Nicole strips sand from the north beach. SB 4-D creates milestone inspections and SIRS.
60-year recertification due. Pompano Beach Fishing Village and pier reopen.
New FEMA coastal flood maps effective July 31.
HB 913 narrows milestone/SIRS scope to 3+ habitable stories; city publishes its Vulnerability Assessment (March).
Unit listed at $399,900 (Feb) and cut to $299,900 by October. Fannie/Freddie end Limited Review for condos (Aug 3).
